conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: For a client branding project, it’s worth keeping visual assets and workplace identity records in separate, access-controlled locations. Avoid placing badge photos or biometric identifiers in shared project folders unless there is a clear business need.

conversation.speaker: user_agent

conversation.message: Keep that information out of client-facing folders, portfolio backups, and general cloud-sync locations. Store it only in the organization’s approved access-controlled system, and check whether the file name or enrollment ID is exposed in filenames, previews, or metadata.
